items.title: Encoded secures $275m for Dravet syndrome gene therapy
items.summary: Proceeds will go towards a pivotal trial of the candidate in paediatric patients.

items.title: Podcast: key readouts from ESC and ERS
items.summary: The healthcare team dive into the latest data and emerging trends from the ESC Congress and ERS Congress.

items.title: Bayer’s Hyrnuo set for the NSCLC frontlines on accelerated FDA label expansion
items.summary: Thoracic oncologists previously touted the potential of Bayer's Hyrnuo in HER2-mutant NSCLC in both the first- and second-line settings.

items.title: HHS appoints permanent FDA CBER, CDER heads
items.summary: The HHS appoints these leadership positions as it looks to “reform” the FDA, which has recently faced a high turnover in leadership.

items.title: Solstice Oncology secures $225m to drive porustobart’s development for cancer
items.summary: Solstice Oncology has secured $225m to advance its lead candidate, porustobart, a neoadjuvant immuno-oncology therapy.
